item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 motion-graphics ad for the fictional planning app DayNest. Exactly three scenes, each exactly 3 seconds, hard cuts at 3.0 and 6.0 seconds. Flat vector graphic design, warm cream background (#F6F1E5), forest green (#245943) and sage green shapes. Clean, simple animated calendar shapes and checkmarks only. Locked camera, uncluttered generous negative space, large crisp centered typography. ABSOLUTELY NO AUDIO. Exact typography is essential. The ONLY visible words anywhere throughout the video are the following three lines, one per scene, preserving exact spelling, capitals and punctuation. Do not render quote marks or scene labels. Scene 1, 0.0–3.0 seconds: display exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.' as one centered line, continuously readable for the full scene; beneath it, simple blank calendar tiles gently slide into alignment and a green checkmark draws itself. Scene 2, 3.0–6.0 seconds: replace prior text completely with exactly 'Plan your day in one place.' as one centered line, continuously readable for the full scene; beneath it, blank rounded calendar shapes smoothly gather into one tidy calendar outline with simple checkmarks. Scene 3, 6.0–9.0 seconds: replace prior text completely with exactly 'Try DayNest today.' as one centered line, continuously readable for the full scene; below, a large green checkmark settles inside a simple blank calendar outline. No other visible words, letters, numbers, dates, weekday names, app UI labels, logos, watermarks, captions or background text. Calendar graphics must have blank cells, abstract bars or dots only, no glyphs. No extra DayNest wordmark. No extra ending slate. No text morphing or text animation; each line remains static and exact within its scene. Simple smooth restrained animation of shapes, polished friendly minimalist aesthetic.
